text: 香港证监会行政总裁梁凤仪表示，延长交易时段将率先在衍生产品市场推行，而港交所会在今季就延长现货市场交易时段发布讨论文件，届时欢迎大家提出意见。
text_en: Hong Kong Securities and Futures Commission CEO Julia Leung said that extending trading hours will first be implemented in the derivatives market, while HKEX will publish a discussion paper this quarter on extending trading hours in the cash market, and welcomes opinions at that time.
